stops.title: Groth
stops.caption: Nyu mɛmba dɛn, ɔva tɛm.
stops.speech: Groth ripɔt de kawnt nyu mɛmba dɛn ɔva di tɛm, usay dɛn jɔyn, ɛn aw dat tan agens di mɔnt dɛn bifo.

stops.title: Nyu Mɛmba dɛn
stops.caption: Usay dɛn kɔmɔt.
stops.speech: Di brek dɔŋ de sho wetin branch ɛn wetin we dɛn kam tru, so yu kin si wetin de bring pipul fɔ tru.
